reuse.why: Still calls applyWeekendRule for moved occurrences, but the new daily-skip rule sits next to it rather than inside the shared weekend definition.

duplication.why: 'skipWeekend && frequency === daily' plus an isWeekend check, and a guard that disables applyWeekendRule for daily schedules, are written separately in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and createScheduleList.

placement.why: The rule belongs in shared/schedules.ts next to applyWeekendRule, but two of the three copies sit in server/schedules/app.ts and budget/schedule-template.ts.

scope.why: Focused on the weekend rule; threading frequency through parseRecurDate is a needed supporting change, and getUpcomingDates is restructured from a map chain into a loop.

maintainability.why: Weekend handling is now split between applyWeekendRule (move) and three ad-hoc skip branches, each with its own way of looking ahead (take 14, count*7+14, per-month loop); a future change has to update all of them.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and createScheduleList each decide 'daily + skipWeekend means skip' themselves and turn applyWeekendRule off for it, instead of extending applyWeekendRule or a shared occurrence helper

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily-skip predicate is written as skipsDailyWeekends/isSkippedOccurrence (schedule-template), skipDaily (schedules/app) and skipWeekend && isDaily (shared/schedules), each with a different loop shape

one_place.where: The daily-skip rule is decided separately in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList
